strategy_roster.name: Multi-Factor
strategy_roster.entry_long: macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9) and rsi(close,14) < 70 and close > sma(close,50) and sma(close,50) > sma(close,200)
strategy_roster.exit_long: macd(close,12,26) < macd_signal(close,12,26,9) or close < sma(close,50) or sma(close,50) < sma(close,200)
strategy_roster.notes: All documented MACD(12,26,9), RSI(14), and SMA(50/200) long filters are exact, with factor failure as exit. ATR(14) 2x/3x stops and targets are dynamic and cannot be encoded as fixed percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Sample Check Pending Order
strategy_roster.notes: A prior ten-bar high break is a fallback for the continuously refreshed buy-stop; no values are documented for the source's levels. Bid/ask pending orders, margin checks, expiration, and point stop/target are outside the candle DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Triple SMA Crossover
strategy_roster.entry_long: sma(close,5) > sma(close,20) > sma(close,50) and sma(close,5) - sma(close,20) > 0.1 * std(close,20)
strategy_roster.notes: SMA(5/20/50) ordering is an explicit fallback because the docs provide only names; a spread above 0.1 standard deviation proxies the unspecified SMA-spread filter. The bearish fast/medium cross exits, and no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Bitcoin Intraday Seasonality
strategy_roster.notes: Four-bar negative momentum approximates the documented UTC 00:00-03:59 holding window on the available daily bars. Exact clock hours, minimum USD sizing, hourly data, and Bitcoin-specific selection cannot be represented.

strategy_roster.name: Multi Indicator Swing
strategy_roster.entry_long: adx(high,low,close,14) > 25 and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1 and close > ema(close,20) and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20) is a SuperTrend-direction proxy, while documented ADX(14)>25 and above-average volume supply confirmation. PSAR and volume delta are unavailable; StopLossPercent=2 and TakeProfitPercent=4 are retained exactly.

strategy_roster.name: Captain Backtest Model
strategy_roster.notes: A retracement confirmed by a bullish close above the prior ten-bar high approximates the morning-bias entry; ten bars are a fallback. Session windows, morning-range state, and the 25/75-point risk-reward exits are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: 2DLimits
strategy_roster.notes: Positive two-bar momentum approximates a rising daily stair-step, and a break above the prior daily high is the long stop-order trigger. Exact last-two-day OHLC state, midpoint stop, range target, and bid/ask arming are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Resampling Reverse Engineering Bands
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger(20,2) low/mid bands proxy the reverse-engineered RSI price levels; 20 bars and deviation 2 are fallbacks. The actual RRSI thresholds, resampled RSI state, and opposite upper-band exit are not directly available; no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Specific Day & Time Orders
strategy_roster.notes: The first valid positive-price bar approximates one scheduled long market order, with an impossible negative-price exit. Timestamps, stop/limit placement, pending expiry, sizing, trailing, break-even, and point protection require unsupported time/order state.

strategy_roster.name: RM Stochastic Band
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) at the documented 20/80 levels plus Bollinger(20,2) extremes proxy agreement across the three stochastic timeframes. Actual stochastic lines, multi-timeframe aggregation, margin/spread filters, and ATR(14) 1.5x/3x protection are unsupported.
